name: render_undo_roundtrip
description: RU-1 and RU-1b: Undo and Redo of render edits, on RD-1 and RD-1b. A Pass Editor edit (present draws the fixture's inverting fragment, which the viewport shows) is taken back with the Frame Plan's Undo -- the picture and get_render_authoring_context are what they were -- and put again with its Redo. Decompose into loop is taken back with Edit > Undo Render Edit (the Frame Plan draws the material pass again, the graph holds no loop), put again with Redo, and taken back once more. Add fullscreen pass writes a fragment file of its own: Undo takes the pass and the file away (get_render_documents and the file say so), the same name can be added again, and after another Undo, Redo writes it back. Last, a Pass Editor edit followed by moving present on the Frame Plan (which rewrites the root's layout) is still undone, and the placement stays.
